page.overview:
What is Babil Region?

The Babil Region is a region located in Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy. It is reached by traversing through The Dragon Scars. It is first visited in Chapter 10, "Too Warm a Welcome".

The Babil Region is one of the four locations in Grymoire that cannot be fast-traveled to by a Gate or the airship, the others being the Bridge Overlook, Cornelia Region, and Desert Region.

The Babil Region serves as the setting for the storyline Intervention Quest, .

Located in the south of the region. It is the first part of the region to be visited.
